name: wallpaper-picker
title: Wallpaper Picker
description: Search wallhaven, preview wallpapers in a grid and apply one across every display, re-syncing the pywal palette.
author: lucasteloeken

commands.name: search-wallpapers
commands.title: Search Wallpapers
commands.subtitle: wallhaven
commands.description: Search wallhaven and set the result as your wallpaper.

preferences.name: dotfilesPath
preferences.title: Dotfiles Path
preferences.description: Repository holding scripts/set_wallpaper.sh, which applies the wallpaper and re-syncs the palette.

preferences.name: wallpaperDir
preferences.title: Wallpaper Folder
preferences.description: Where the full resolution downloads are kept. macOS references this file, so it must persist.

preferences.name: minResolution
preferences.title: Minimum Resolution
preferences.description: Only show wallpapers at least this large.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Wallhaven API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Only needed for restricted content and a higher rate limit.
